source_family.uv_orientation: LVECTR2 U0 is long box rear end localY10.64; U1 is cab end localY-1.977. Preserve printed/photo wheel placement near cab; do not mirror advertisement.

artwork_contract.motifs: White/blue truck, exactly one printed yellow road-going Vectra,3 stackedVECTRA words,red Vauxhall roundel+VAUXHALL,Mobil1,plain unlettered yellow underline. Quiet unbranded body skins and original gold lower trim.
artwork_contract.alpha: Exact canonical RGB-black-key alpha normalized1:1 and nearest-scaled to output; source-white opaque. Newly source-opaque generator gaps receive valid generated RGB continuation and source dark ink protection.
artwork_contract.flat_sampler: LVOLVO4 original pixel30,16 → C3DUV(.953125,-.484375) → imageUV(.953125,.515625). SourceRGBA16,24,41,255 exceptSnet16,16,66,255; final decoded bilinear footprints per output.
